# Sarah-cat

## Overview

- **Age:** eight years old  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Sarah-cat is a large, sleek, gray-and-white cat. She possesses an enormous sense of dignity that remains unaffected by her plebeian origins.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah-cat is an eight-year-old cat known for being a remarkable mouser. She never engages in fights.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## History

The Sarah-cat was originally given to [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) by her washerwoman. She moved into Patty's Place alongside [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), quickly asserting dominance over the newly adopted stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md). Later, during an unexpected and awkward visit from [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) Gardner's mother and sisters, the Sarah-cat was among the household's cats that acted rambunctiously.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rusty--sarah-cat.md)

The Sarah-cat and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) are stray cats brought together when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends take them in while settling into Patty's Place. Upon their arrival, the Sarah-cat quickly asserts dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), though they eventually learn to live together in the household.
